description:
Istanbul Kultur University started its education activities in higher education with 157 students and 32 academic staff in 1997−1998 academic year. In the 1997-1998 academic year, the Faculty of Arts and Sciences, the Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences (three faculties, namely the Faculty of Engineering and Architecture; In the fields of Business Administration Program and Computer Programming, Vocational Schools of Business Administration and Technical Sciences with 157 students and an academic staff of 32 people. started its activities.

On the E-5 Highway and on the TEM Highway, 70216 m2 closed and 57.750 m2 open area, a total of 127966 square meters, serving in four separate campuses of the university, Faculty of Science and Letters, Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Architecture, Faculty of Art and Design, Graduate Education The Institute provides education and training services.

There are Faculty of Law, Vocational School of Justice, Department of Foreign Languages ​​and Faculty of Health Sciences in Şirinevler Campus. IKU Vocational School programs continue their educational activities in İncirli Campus.

The Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences and the Faculty of Education continue their activities in the Basın Ekspres Campus, which was opened in the 2018-2019 academic year. Ataköy campus, which is used as the main campus, also includes the Rectorate and its affiliated administrative units. All campuses of Istanbul Kultur University are easily accessible as they are located at the intersections of land, air and seaway and rail system transportation, and it has the characteristics of a city university in terms of the dense population in its immediate vicinity.

Considering culture and art as an indispensable part of academic and scientific education, Istanbul Kultur University has hosted many national and international cultural events since its establishment in 1997.
